content_zh:
如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    停车场里面，豪车倒是不少，从奔驰宝马到顶级房车应有尽有。
很多显然都是私车的打扮，上面贴着一些很炫的装饰，可以断定是集团员工自己买的车子。
这样一来，从侧面就可以推测出鹏展集团的职员收入有多么高。
如此看来，自己的三万元薪水也算不得很高了。
在福伯的引领下，林逸来到了一辆深蓝色宾利的旁边，车子保养的很不错，不知道是新买不久还是平时很注意，看起来十分的崭新。
“林先生，请上车吧。”
福伯拉开了副驾驶的门，坐了一个请的姿势。
“我坐在副驾驶？那一会儿大小姐……？”
林逸迟疑了一下问道。
“小姐每天都是坐在后排的。”
福伯说道：“她有书包，坐在前排不方便。”
林逸点了点头，上了车子，福伯驾驶着车子缓缓的驶入了地下停车场。
在经过出口的保安岗时，几个保安都立刻立了正，面色肃然的目送着车子出门。
福伯的驾驶技术十分娴熟，不过看的出来，是属于中规中矩那种，和林逸平时所学的并不是一个套路。
林逸学的则是更倾向于赛车，没办法，家里老头子的一句名言就是，打不过不是你的错，打不过还跑不了那就是活该倒霉了。
所以，林逸学了不少逃跑的功夫，虽然这些功夫只针对老头子一个人用过，在其他人面前，都是别人跑的份儿。
“林先生，你会开车么？”
福伯在等红绿灯的时候，看了一眼静静的坐在自己身边的林逸问道。
福伯是个老司机了，看人也看的十分准。
一般有人坐在车子里，他总能从一些细节上判断出这个人是否会开车，不过林逸显然没有什么特别的反应，所以福伯才问了一句。

“会一点。”
林逸心道，作为新人，还是谦虚一点儿吧。
“有驾照么？”
福伯倒是没有问会一点是会到什么程度，他也知道老板对这个人的信任。
“还没有。”
林逸摇了摇头，他虽然会开车，甚至在国外飚过车，但是却没有驾照：“我刚满十八岁，没来得及办。”
“那好，将你的身份证给我，我帮你办一本驾照，这样如果楚先生和我临时有事，你就可以开车送小姐上下学了。”
福伯说道。
车子停到了一所看起来十分豪华的学校附近，但是并没有上前去，大概也是因为车子实在太过于扎眼了，让其他的同学看到影响不好。
在资料上，林逸已经了解到了，松山市第一高中虽然是一家私立中学，但是却并不是想象中的那种贵族学校一样。
学校是面向全省考试招生的省级重点高中，虽然不乏有一些权贵富豪的子女通过关系进来，但是大部分学生都是通过自身的实力考上来的。
因为背后有三大集团的支持，所以松山第一高中无论在软硬件还是在师资力量上，都胜过其他学校一筹，这也是几年来升学率百分之百的原因。
其实，林逸也明白，这个百分之百肯定是有水分的，有些纨绔子弟根本就不会学习，但是他们最终也上了大学，这就是凭借他们家里的能量了。
熟悉的下课铃声响起，让林逸有些失神，多少年没有再听到这个声音了呢？
不过，短暂的失神过后，林逸又恢复了正常，目光平和的看着学校的操场上。
没过多久，就有学生陆续的从教学楼中走了出来。
有穿着校服的，也有穿着其他衣服的，一般来说，没有什么大型活动，学校对于学生的穿着也不会做特别的要求。
“那个就是小姐。”
福伯忽然抬起手，指向不远处的走出来的一群男女学生中间的一个女孩子。
林逸顺着福伯手指的方向看去，那是一个身材高挑又十分靓丽的女孩子，虽然她的身边还有其他的女孩子，不过林逸只看一眼，就猜到了这位一定是大小姐。

因为之前老头子说过了，楚梦瑶是学校的校花！
所谓校花吗，应该就是最漂亮的那位，除非林逸的审美观点有问题。
虽然在她身边的另一位女孩子的相貌也十分出众，但是身材却娇小了一些，明显的和资料上的身高不符合。
不过却也属于挺有潜力的校花候选人之一，长大了绝对是祸国殃民的那一类。
楚梦瑶和那个女孩子一起正快步的向车子这边走来，不过几个公子哥模样的男生却是在后面穷追不舍。
“梦瑶，你等等……”

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author’s quick channel for copyright complaints. There are many luxury cars in the parking lot, ranging from Mercedes-Benz and BMW to top-end RVs.
Many of them are obviously private cars, with some dazzling decorations on them. It can be concluded that they are cars bought by the group employees themselves.
In this way, we can infer from the side how high the income of Pengzhan Group's employees is.
From this point of view, my salary of 30,000 yuan is not very high.
Under the guidance of Uncle Fu, Lin Yi came to the side of a dark blue Bentley. The car was very well maintained. I don't know if it was new or if I paid close attention to it. It looked very brand new.
"Mr. Lin, please get in the car."
Fubo opened the passenger door and sat down in a please gesture.
"I'm sitting in the passenger seat? Then Miss...?"
Lin Yi hesitated and asked.
"Miss sits in the back row every day."
"She has a schoolbag and it's inconvenient to sit in the front row," Fubo said.
Lin Yi nodded and got into the car. Uncle Fu drove the car slowly into the underground parking lot.
When passing the security guard at the exit, several security guards immediately stood at attention and watched the car go out with solemn expressions.
Fu Bo's driving skills are very skilled, but it can be seen that they are quite satisfactory and are not the same as what Lin Yi usually learns.
Lin Yi is more interested in racing. There is nothing he can do. A famous saying of the old man in his family is that it is not your fault that you can't beat him. If you can't beat him and can't run, then you deserve to be unlucky.
Therefore, Lin Yi learned a lot of escape skills. Although these skills were only used on the old man, in front of others, they were all for others to escape.
"Mr. Lin, can you drive?"
While Fu Bo was waiting at the traffic light, he glanced at Lin Yi who was sitting quietly next to him and asked.
Uncle Fu is an experienced driver, and he can read people very accurately.
Usually when someone is sitting in a car, he can always tell whether the person can drive from some details, but Lin Yi obviously didn't have any special reaction, so Fu Bo asked.
"Know a little."
Lin Yi thought to himself, as a newcomer, he should be more modest.
"Do you have a driver's license?"
Fu Bo didn't ask to what extent a little knowledge would go to. He also knew that the boss trusted this man.
"Not yet."
Lin Yi shook his head. Although he could drive and even drove abroad, he did not have a driver's license: "I just turned eighteen and didn't have time to do it."
"Okay, give me your ID card, and I'll get you a driver's license, so if Mr. Chu and I have something to do, you can drive the lady to and from school."
Fubo said.
The car parked near a very luxurious-looking school, but he did not go forward, probably because the car was too eye-catching and would have a negative impact on other students.
From the information, Lin Yi has learned that although Songshan City No. 1 High School is a private middle school, it is not the aristocratic school he imagined.
The school is a provincial key high school that admits students through provincial examinations. Although there are some children of rich and powerful people who come in through connections, most of the students are admitted through their own merits.
Because there are three major groups behind it, Songshan No. 1 High School is superior to other schools in terms of software, hardware and teaching staff. This is also the reason why the admission rate has been 100% in recent years.
In fact, Lin Yi also understands that this is 100% certain. There are some dudes who don't know how to study at all, but they eventually went to college because of the energy of their families.
The familiar bell rang, making Lin Yi a little distracted. How many years had he not heard this sound again?
However, after a brief absence, Lin Yi returned to normal, looking calmly at the school playground..
Not long after, students walked out of the teaching building one after another.
Some are wearing school uniforms, and some are wearing other clothes. Generally speaking, there are no large-scale activities, and the school does not have special requirements for students' clothing.
"That's Miss."
Uncle Fu suddenly raised his hand and pointed at a girl among a group of male and female students who were walking out not far away.
Lin Yi looked in the direction of Uncle Fu's finger. It was a tall and beautiful girl. Although there were other girls around her, Lin Yi guessed at just one glance that this must be the eldest lady.
Because the old man said before, Chu Mengyao is the school beauty!
The so-called school beauty should be the most beautiful one, unless there is something wrong with Lin Yi's aesthetic point of view.
Although the other girl next to her also has an outstanding appearance, her figure is a bit petite, which obviously does not match the height listed in the information.
However, she is also one of the potential school beauty candidates. When she grows up, she will definitely bring disaster to the country and the people.
Chu Mengyao and the girl were walking quickly towards the car, but several young men who looked like young men were chasing after her.
"Mengyao, wait..."
